title: Space Station Astronaut Discusses Record Breaking Mission with Previous Record Holder (NASA Johnson Space Center, public domain)
method: Labelled from the text of the whisper.cpp base transcript of hosted run 39527538316 (who asks, who answers, who is addressed by name, and the '>>' turn marks), without listening. The run printed each engine's labels beside the text; they were not used to decide a turn. Each turn runs over whole transcript segments, so its bounds are segment bounds (precision about one segment); a segment that holds two speakers is unscored. Read on 2026-10-21.

speakers.A: the caller on the ground, the previous record holder, who asks the questions
speakers.B: the astronaut on the station, who answers
speakers.C: the ground controller who closes the event (the last nine seconds)

count_note: The count a user would give for a two-person call; the controller's closing words are a third voice the user may not count, so a known-count run is asked for two.

unscored.why: the call-up ('Station, Houston ...'): the caller or the controller
one segment holds A's question and B's one-line answer
